quality.reason: Well-structured scan with links, engagement metrics, and ranked scores, but signal quality is mixed: the bullish 📈 tag on a negative ETF-delay tweet is a misclassification, the HTX listing is already live (stale), and whale transfers to unknown wallets are often ambiguous cold-storage moves rather than actionable signals.

Well-structured status report with real metrics (PnL, WR, fleet health, tagged news), but duplicate ETH signals, an empty news tag [[]], and moderate signal strengths without clear action recommendations limit its actionability.

Well-structured performance review with a genuinely actionable signal — BTC's assigned strategy flagged as losing to runner-up with declining trend, plus capital tracking and clear per-pair strategy health comparisons.

Well-structured digest that leads with genuinely differentiated signals (HYPE 82% bid-weighted book, whale short-building) supported by a clean multi-metric table, though the identical 0.0013% funding rates across all coins hint at possible stale data.

Well-structured review with quantified per-component metrics, clear severity indicators (✅/⚠️/❌), and specific actionable flags like 0% uptime on whale-mon, meta broken 136d, and 94.8% signal bridge waste — though chronically repeating unactioned alerts suggests an escalation mechanism is needed.

Well-structured, on-topic research scan with transparent failure handling (documented API timeout fallback and claimed verification of all 5 paper IDs via arxiv.org/abs), relevant paper details with proper links, and only minor confidence reduction from the degraded web-search discovery path.

A correctly-executed silent scan is valuable signal: it reports specific data (max 4.0pp shift, Fed market detail), properly filters out mechanical expiry-market repricing per skill rules, avoids false alerts, and still fulfills cron duties by writing full state — only minor markdown formatting glitch in the header.

Presents a falsifiable, actionable thesis (signal system has no alpha, profits are beta from SOL uptrend) backed by a structured quantitative evidence table with specific per-asset accuracy and move metrics, which directly informs whether to trust or retire the fleet's signals.
